question: The Battle of Chandawar was fought between Muhammad Ghori and _______, a ruler of the Gahadavala dynasty, in 1194.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaichand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Battle of Chandawar** was fought in **1194 **between **Muhammad Ghori **and **Jaichand**, the ruler of the Gahadavala dynasty.
 
• This battle is significant as it **marked the end of the Gahadavala dynasty's rule** and **expanded Muhammad Ghori's influence in Northern India**.
 
• **Jaichand** was defeated and killed in this battle, leading to a significant shift in power dynamics in the region.
 
• The battle was part of Muhammad Ghori's series of campaigns to establish control over Indian territories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Muhammad Ghori**, also known as **Mu'izz ad-Din Muhammad Ghori**, played a crucial role in laying the foundation for Muslim rule in India, which later led to the establishment of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• The Gahadavala dynasty, ruled by **Jaichand**, was known for its patronage of arts and culture in Northern India before its fall.
 
• The defeat of **Jaichand** allowed for the expansion of Islamic rule in the Indian subcontinent, influencing the region's cultural and political landscape.
